set.body:
Type: implementation or qualification task
Work key: H06.1
Program plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Core plan: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Accountable role (person unassigned): Operations/backend engineer
Scope: Build monitoring and test delivery without waiting for an institutional escalation destination.

Work kind: engineering
Acceptance gate: H06 (bd-01M4X8M9S1X431HCYR55D69QA5)
Suggested delivery tranche: T2; actual blocker graph controls readiness.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Instrument DB/pool pressure, request and full-stream concurrency, operation/lease backlog, capacity, integrity and backup/policy-journal age/lag with bounded labels and no sensitive payloads.
2. Define local engineering thresholds and send real notifications to a loopback test receiver; inject each supported alert, verify payload/delivery/dedup/recovery and model receiver outage/retry.
3. Retain receipt and secret-canary checks, including credential/identity/source-path leakage; document which measurements become available as producers land. H06 review requires all producers connected, and institutional alert routing/ack remains O02.2.

Verification: Metric/threshold fixtures plus actual local receiver receipts, receiver-failure and secret-canary tests; no messages sent to people.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/H06.1/receipt.json
Evidence fields: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input

Source/contracts:
- docs/core-hardening-plan.md
- docs/local-demo-plan.md

Blocked by:
- O02.1: bd-01M4W5P86V3ZV697KZ1F85XFM4

Completion: satisfy every criterion with source/artifact/configuration-bound observed evidence. Integrity, unauthorized disclosure, resurrected authority or false success block release. Local engineering and simulated provider/component-loss evidence do not close real institutional/provider/human/physical-host-loss gates. Existing completed work is not reopened or relabeled by this planning revision.
set.title: H06.1: Implement operational metrics and locally verified alert delivery
